senses.gloss:
शिङ्घाण n. (-णं)
 1. Any glass-vessel.
 2. The mucus of the nose.
 3. Rust
of iron.
 m. (-णः)
 1. Phlegm.
 2. Froth, foam.
 E. शिघि to smell,
आणच् Unādi affix, and the final optionally rejected; also शिङ्घाणक
and सिङ्घाणक ।

सिङ्घाण n. (-णं)
 1. The mucus of the nose.
 2. Rust of iron.
 E. शिघि to
smell, Unādi aff. आनक्, and the last syllable of the aff. optionally
rejected; also सिङ्घाणक n. (-कं): see सिंहान ।

शिङ्घाणक m. (-कः) Phlegm.
 mn. (-कः-कं) The mucus of the nose.
 E. शिघि to smell, aff. आणच् ।

शिङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled.
 E. शिघि to smell, aff. क्त्र ।

सिङ्घिनी f. (-नी) The nose.
 E. शिघि to smell, affs. इनि and ङीप्, the initial changed.
